criteria.criterion: Provide concrete clean/minimal inline player design alternatives at realistic thread widths for owner selection.
criteria.evidence: factory/work-items/DIAL-005/design/player-directions.html contains A Studio, B Editorial, and C Slim; approved PRODUCT.md records Studio. Local Chromium screenshots for fixed and country layouts are documented in factory/work-items/DIAL-005/evidence/polish-review.md.
criteria.method: Inspected the A/B/C local design comparison and approved PRODUCT.md selection; rendered the selected candidate at 320px and 560px in local Chromium.

criteria.criterion: Selected design preserves regular player takeover, remote Pause and clear honest playback/error states.
criteria.evidence: Rendered fixed-error, fixed-remote, and country-buffering fixtures show readable actionable error, cautious remote status with Pause action, and connecting status without claiming playback. Prior Verify run-bdeca29eb9fb recorded npm test: 28 passed, 0 failed on this SHA, including takeover and remote Pause semantics. Screenshots and limits are documented in evidence/polish-review.md.
criteria.method: Inspected candidate state markup and 320px static renders of remote, error, and buffering states; relied on the prior independent Verify's 28-test execution on this exact candidate for behavioral coordination checks.

criteria.criterion: Design covers fixed player, bounded country list, light/dark themes, narrow widths and accessible controls.
criteria.evidence: Fixed and ten-row country screenshots in /tmp/dial005-visual show readable opaque surfaces, visible Play control, selected check, wrapped full names, and no visible clipping or overlap at tested widths. Candidate markup uses native buttons and role=status/aria-live; CSS defines :focus-visible. Actual keyboard focus rendering was not captured. See evidence/polish-review.md.
criteria.method: Rendered candidate resources in headless Chromium at 320px and 560px in light and dark modes with ten representative rows and a deliberately long name; inspected screenshots, native button markup, status live regions, focus CSS, and selected-state text/check cues.

criteria.criterion: Approved design implementation passes meaningful resource/interaction regression checks and independent Review/Verify, including actual host visual QA.
criteria.evidence: Independent Review run-eb32cd2d2028 ACCEPT and Verify run-bdeca29eb9fb recorded 28 passing tests on this candidate. This run adds local 320px/560px light/dark screenshots, but no actual ChatGPT host rendering, keyboard traversal, audio, takeover, or remote Pause observation was available. Local rendering cannot satisfy the required host QA.
criteria.method: Checked exact candidate SHA and prior independent Review/Verify records; performed local Chromium visual inspection. Sought actual host evidence in the available record.
